scope: XAI bundle publication, loading, model reconstruction and calibration
observations: Evidence readers reject traversal, symlinks, duplicate IDs, unlisted files and hash mismatches.
JSON evidence validation does not deserialize checkpoints. Perturbation uses existing trusted-model loading and verifies retained role hashes before execution.
Publish destinations are new; exclusive locks, staging and completion markers separate incomplete artifacts.
Error artifacts omit exception text that may contain source data.
Hashes establish consistency, not authenticity against an attacker replacing the manifest and payload.
limitations: No ProdSec or authoritative release sign-off.
Canonical Pulse secret scanner unavailable: Docker socket access denied.
License scanner unavailable; dependency runner reported source-only scope with no dependency manifest changes.
